posts.name: Nepid
posts.cooked: Well to start things off we were at Metropolis, it was me and my fiance 3rd game ever, I played Haka and Legacy, she played Wraith and Visionary our villian was Citizen Dawn, spent a few turns chipping away the minions that spawned, decided about turn 2 might be a good idea to flip citizen dawn, (based on baron) end up making her flip, “citizen dawn is immune to damage while on this side”, look at fiance “oh s***” continue playing game train comes out for metropolis, citizen dawn gets about 6 citizens a turn, flips to receive damage every other turn. Make strategy to just deal all damage to her till one side breaks. End result citizen dawn 1 hp due to legacy being koed and loses buffs for damage…all our heroes are koed in 1 turn. We may have lost but holy crap that was a good game. Teaching best friend of 17 years how to play soon.
